style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium home-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep pine-green backdrop #175A4F, warm cream panel #F7F3EA, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one warm sand-orange accent #F6B14B; soft diffused warm studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline type in charcoal #2D2D2D on light grounds and warm cream #F7F3EA on dark grounds; consistent rounded info cards and thin-line icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the control unit and blanket always presented as one system at a stable hero angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
